description: This Java interface defines the configuration settings for a cache, including methods to retrieve cache parameters such as maximum size and expiration durations, along with an embedded enum for default configuration values.

classes.name: CacheConfig.CacheConfigValue
classes.description: An enum defining known configuration path expressions and default values for CacheConfig settings.

methods.name: getMaximumSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of entries the cache can hold.

methods.name: getExpireAfterWrite
methods.description: Returns the duration after which a cache entry expires following a write.

methods.name: getExpireAfterAccess
methods.description: Returns the duration after which a cache entry expires following last access.

methods.name: getExpireAfterCreate
methods.description: Returns the duration after which a cache entry expires after creation.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Provides a Config representation of the CacheConfig object for serialization or reconstruction.
